title: Links in posts become links, and a room, broadcast or recording link becomes a card under the post

tasks.title: Posts carry an optional embed of a room, broadcast or recording, checked by the server
verify: npm run test:integration -- api.post-embeds api.posts api.repost

tasks.title: Links in post text, and the card in the composer and in posts

acs.text: WHEN a room, broadcast or recording link (`/social/r/<id>`, `/social/b/<id>` or `/social/rec/<id>`, as a path or an http(s) URL on a Sefaria origin or the page's own origin) is pasted or typed into the composer THE SYSTEM SHALL take the first such link out of the text and show it as a card under the text with a remove button; removing the card SHALL put the link back into the text where it was; a second such link SHALL stay plain text (one card per post)
scenarios: AC-001 a pasted room link becomes a card, and removing it restores the text

acs.text: WHEN a post is written with `embed: {kind, id}` (`room`, `broadcast` or `recording`) THE SYSTEM SHALL check that the target exists and that the author is in its room (its owner or a member) and answer 201 with the post carrying `embed: {kind, id, title, leader}`; an unknown target, or one in a room the author is not in, SHALL be refused with 404 and no post created; a post with an embed may have empty text
scenarios: AC-002 the server checks the embedded target

acs.text: WHEN a post has no embed THE SYSTEM SHALL answer it in every API response exactly as before, with no `embed` field
scenarios: AC-003 posts without an embed are unchanged

acs.text: WHEN a post's text contains an http or https URL THE SYSTEM SHALL render it as a link with `rel="noopener nofollow"` opening in a new tab; any other scheme (for example `javascript:`) SHALL stay text
scenarios: AC-004 URLs in a post are links

acs.text: WHEN a post has an embed THE SYSTEM SHALL show a card in the post with the target's title, the leader's name and one button, Join (room), Watch (broadcast) or Play (recording), that goes to the target's page through the host; a target that no longer exists SHALL show "no longer available" and no button
scenarios: AC-005 the card in a post
